headline: Quiet Saturday: Opus 5.5 is plenty, no need to rush to switch
summary: No big launches today, just one real-world test: Fable 5.2 costs 2.8x more and didn't score noticeably better at coding.

items.title: Update: Opus is enough as your Claude Code default
items.pitch: Update: Garry Tan tested 52 coding tasks, and Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 scored about the same, but Fable costs 2.8x more per solved task.
why: Scores were about 82.7% vs 84.6%, a tiny gap
Fable 5.2 costs 2.80x more per solved task
Your weekly quota is limited, so the cheaper default is the better deal
actions: In Claude Code, use /model to set your default model to Opus 5.5
For really hard tasks, switch to Fable 5.2 just for that one
deep_dive: Garry Tan ran this on Claude Code 2.1.322 with only 52 tasks. He admits the tasks were too easy, so Opus could already solve most of them, which is why you can't really tell the two apart.
So the takeaway is just don't blindly use the most expensive model. On harder tasks Fable 5.2 might still be stronger, so try it yourself.
He also put out an open-source eval repo. You don't need to read the code, just know it exists.

items.title: Peter Yang's medical records skill
items.pitch: Drop your medical records into a cloud drive folder, add this free skill to ChatGPT or Claude, and it'll make a one-page summary and look up clinical trials.
why: Non-developers can use it too, just give your AI a link and it installs
Shows how a skill can turn into an everyday little tool
